ac12_note: AC-12's test passed even before implementation, since nothing touched reminders then — it was never a load-bearing red. Both the code-reviewer and the post-green reviewer independently re-derived that it is nonetheless a genuine guard now: the recompute selects on isNull(reminders.sentAt), so removing or weakening that filter would move the sent Reminder's fireAt to a computably different value and fail the test's own assertion.
